html:
Human frontopolar cortex plays a causal role in decomposing high-dimensional information during decision making

Also called "frontopolar PFC" and "anterior PFC"

Least well-understood part of the brain?

Region of highest-order relational processing?

The corresponding Brodmann area is the largest cytoarchitectonic area in the human brain, meaning ...

has the lowest neuron density among primate brains, and its neurons have particularly extensive dendritic arborization and are highly dense with dendritic spines

"it seems not to be interconnected with ‘downstream’ areas in the way that other prefrontal areas are. .. it is the only prefrontal region that is predominantly (and possibly exclusively) interconnected with supramodal cortex in the PFC, anterior temporal cortex and cingulate cortex." 2
